## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmations: broad sector breadth positive but leadership highly concentrated in Energy, and several mega-cap Tech names are BELOW TREND, producing offsetting signals.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND. Financials follow: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 of Top 5 from Energy). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND and sector down. Consumer Discretionary soft: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND. Materials showing mild weakness: FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership concentrated in Energy (Narrow).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION, HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select cyclicals and consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE (MSFT, AMZN, TSLA all show 1W vs 1M mismatches) — watch for trend breaks and avoid over-interpreting single-week moves.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed internals with pockets of strength and notable large-cap weakness: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND; but AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +23.51%) CORRECTION. Tech breadth: 12/24 positive.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Healthy and constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Financials breadth: 14/20 positive and supportive of cyclical/value tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed but tilted positive: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare breadth: 10/17 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and selective Financials given narrow but strong leadership; reduce exposure to Consumer Staples and lagging Consumer Discretionary names. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but maintain caution due to concentrated leadership and major-cap Tech divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND (follow-through after earnings-driven surge), CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: 9/10 positive) — leadership and earnings momentum. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (Breadth: 2/14 positive) — sharp underperformance and headline risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND — watch decisive close above prior July highs as continuation trigger. AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — watch 170 area as near-term support (failure increases downside risk). XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND — sustained move above recent consolidation would confirm Energy rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (+75): Berkshire adds $17B to stake; GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline but price diverging (distribution signal). MPC (+60): Marathon Q2 beat headlines; MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action. BA (+60): 737-7 FAA approval; BA (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) CORRECTION — news constructive but short-term pullback.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
CRM (-75): large negative headline on leverage and guidance; CRM (1W: -X% | 1M: +Y%) CORRECTION — sentiment aligns with recent softness (monitor for follow-through). CSCO (-50): analyst downgrades; CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION — price reaction confirms risk. UNP (-45): merger scrutiny; UNP (1W: -X% | 1M: +Y%) — negative headline risk to watch (monitor operational updates). 

(Note: CRM and UNP price deltas flagged as CORRECTION/at-risk per sentiment; use internal quotes for precise intraday levels.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy leadership and Financials strength despite mixed big-tech internals. MPC, VLO, PSX (all ABOVE TREND) are showing the clearest relative strength while AAPL and GOOGL remain BELOW TREND. Key risk is concentrated leadership and MAJOR DIVERGENCE among mega-caps (MSFT, AMZN, TSLA mismatches) and several headline-driven sentiment divergences to monitor.
